minutes.headline: Planning Board recommended no action or withdrawal of the water supply protection article, and approved a battery storage bylaw.
minutes.summary: The board approved its first common driveway special permit subject to a written decision, continued the 255 Sunny Hill stormwater hearing to June, and recommended no action/withdrawal on the Water Supply Protection District article. It recommended the battery energy storage bylaw to town meeting, agreed to a performance-guarantee path for stormwater sign-offs, approved a site plan modification for an indoor golf and sports bar, and issued a certificate of completion for 360 Flat Hill Road.

public_comment.topic: Asked the board to allow the Pledge of Allegiance to be led at meetings; board agreed members could lead it before the meeting.
Concerns about the dangerous corner, traffic and drainage/ice near the proposed common driveway at 728 Goodrich.
Asked how disputes between owners sharing a common driveway are resolved.

public_comment.stated_role: owner of the Sunny Hill property
public_comment.topic: Asked to proceed with the three Sunny Hill lots separately from lot five, given distance from wetlands.
Opposed building on the 255 Sunny Hill lot, citing wetness and the water supply.
Asked how the stormwater decision would affect the Conservation Commission's notice of intent review for lot five.
Presented proposed amendments on the water supply protection bylaw: remove Zone One scope exclusion, special permit for treatment facilities in Zone Two.
Urged adding state definitions of contaminated groundwater and surface water and supported moving the amendments forward.
Urged the board to make a decision on the water bylaw.
Wanted Zone One protections and passive recreation kept in the bylaw.
Attorney or representative for clients urged the board to move forward and recommend the article.
Concerned residents will be confused by changes to the warrant text and asked what harm in not proceeding.
Said the bylaw is not ready and asked about state law versus local rules for Zone One recreation.
A resident asked that the board communicate clearly before May 4th exactly what wording will be presented.

budget_items.what_was_said: Board set a performance guarantee for up to six months to cover rain garden vegetation, subject to engineer review.
A suggested bond figure was objected to by the developer, who gave his own cost estimates for the rain gardens and plants.
Board discussed possible guarantee amounts, with the interim director favouring a higher figure than the developer's.

budget_items.what_was_said: Board approved return of the guarantee after the engineer's report found the work consistent with plans.

decisions.decision: Chair left it to board members to volunteer to lead the pledge before meetings, by saying so or emailing him; one member agreed to do it.

For 430 Mopus/lot two, developer to complete lot two, submit as-built and cost estimate for remaining stormwater work by about May 1st, Graves to review, and the board will consider a performance guarantee at the next meeting.
Interim director to lay out the stormwater sign-off process in writing before June 10th; next meeting date confirmed as May 13th.
Interim director plans to leave a complete draft of the water supply bylaw for his successor before his last meeting on June 10th.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to recommend that town meeting withdraw the Water Supply Protection District article, or take no action if withdrawal is not permitted.
The board voted to recommend that town meeting adopt the battery energy storage systems bylaw, with a scrivener's correction.
The board approved a common driveway special permit at 728 Goodrich Street, subject to a written decision with conditions at its next meeting.
The 255 Sunny Hill stormwater permit hearing was continued to June 10th, after a first date of May 27th was rescinded as Memorial Day.
The board approved a de minimis site plan change for an indoor golf and sports bar and released the performance guarantee for 360 Flat Hill Road.

why_it_matters: Residents will be asked at town meeting to vote on the battery storage bylaw and, unless it is withdrawn, the water supply protection article, and the board's recommendations are the position that meeting will hear.

Stormwater sign-offs on developments such as 255 Sunny Hill, 512 Northfield and 430 Mopus affect drainage and wetland protection near homes, and the board is settling how performance guarantees will back them.
watch_next: The written decision on the 728 Goodrich common driveway permit, due at the board's next meeting, confirmed as May 13th.
The continued 255 Sunny Hill stormwater hearing on June 10th, and the interim director's written stormwater sign-off process, promised before that date.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary:
The two records agree on the main outcomes: the 728 Goodrich permit, the amended Water Supply Protection District motion, the battery storage recommendation, and the Flat Hill release. They differ on votes our video shows that the official minutes omit or leave without an outcome.
A reader should check these votes first: the 255 Sunny Hill continuances, the hearing closings, the first Water Supply Protection District motion, the 512 Northfield sign-off, and the 5 Summer St change of use. The official motion for 5 Summer St reads as approving the use as a Brazilian restaurant.
